cues: Securing a loose cabinet pull restores smooth opening and keeps its threaded hardware from wobbling.
In furniture assembly, evenly tightened fasteners help joints resist movement during everyday use.
A repair kit keeps assorted hand tools ready for adjusting fittings and securing household hardware.
Fastening a mounting bracket firmly prevents appliances from shifting against the wall during use.
Routine bicycle upkeep includes tightening small fittings before vibration loosens nearby components.
A wooden toy stays intact when its metal fasteners are snugged during final assembly.
Service work on machinery relies on turning threaded hardware to keep guards securely attached.
A mounting plate stays stable when its bolts and smaller threaded fasteners are tightened evenly.
